Destinations / Manali & Kullu

Manali & Kullu

Pine forests, rivers and snowy passes within easy reach

Best time: March – June, October. Good mix of easy nature walks and adventure. Mountain roads — drive in daylight.

Highlights

  • Solang Valley adventure sports
  • Old Manali cafés
  • Hot springs of Manikaran
  • Atal Tunnel to Lahaul

Suggested road trips

Kullu–Manali valley drive

4 days · about 160 km. Kullu → Naggar → Manali → Solang → Sissu through the Atal Tunnel.

  1. Bhuntar → Naggar (45 km, about 2 h): Kullu town, then Naggar castle.
  2. Naggar → Manali (25 km, about 1 h): Old Manali and the Vashisht hot springs.
  3. Manali → Sissu (45 km, about 2.5 h): Solang valley, then through the Atal Tunnel.
  4. Sissu → Manali (40 km, about 2 h)

Parvati Valley escape

3 days · about 120 km. Bhuntar → Kasol → Manikaran with riverside camps.

  1. Bhuntar → Kasol (30 km, about 1.5 h)
  2. Kasol → Manikaran & Barshaini (30 km, about 1.5 h): Narrow road; park big vans at Manikaran.
  3. Barshaini → Bhuntar (60 km, about 2.5 h)

Before you go

Manali is at about 2,000 m; Sissu, beyond the Atal Tunnel, about 3,100 m. Mild for most people.

Plenty of pumps in the Kullu valley. Fill up in Manali before heading into Lahaul.

Busy two-lane road with heavy peak-season traffic around Manali; snow at Solang and Sissu in winter. Landslides possible in the monsoon.
